disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部源码与构建产物中读取凭据、密钥、SSH 私钥、云厂商凭证等敏感文件或敏感环境变量的代码路径，未检出；插件读取的数据仅为子代理运行元数据（会话标识、状态、时间戳），不含任何密钥。
checked_items.en: Checked all source code and build artifacts for code paths that read credentials, secrets, SSH private keys, cloud vendor credentials, or other sensitive files or sensitive environment variables; not detected. The data read by the plugin is limited to sub-agent runtime metadata (session identifier, status, timestamps) and contains no credentials.

checked_items.zh: 检查了仓库内是否硬编码 API 密钥、令牌、口令等敏感字面量，未检出。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the repository hardcodes sensitive literals such as API keys, tokens, or passwords; not detected.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器端只向宿主 Web 服务的同源快照接口轮询子代理状态，不接触凭据类接口，也不读取剪贴板或按键输入。
checked_items.en: The browser side only polls the sub-agent status from a same-origin snapshot endpoint of the host web service. It does not touch credential-related interfaces, nor does it read the clipboard or key input.

evidence.zh: 核查了全部源码与构建产物中是否读取凭据类敏感文件或敏感环境变量，未检出任何此类路径；插件读取的数据仅为子代理运行元数据（会话标识、状态、时间戳），凭据读取面为零。
evidence.en: Reviewed all source code and build artifacts for reads of credential-type sensitive files or sensitive environment variables; no such path was detected. The data read by the plugin is limited to sub-agent runtime metadata (session identifier, status, timestamps), so the credential read surface is zero.

checked_items.zh: 该插件未向模型注册任何工具，也未注入系统提示片段，模型面对的文本面为空，工具描述投毒、诱导安装等场景不适用。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers no tools with the model and injects no system prompt fragments. The text surface exposed to the model is empty; scenarios such as tool description poisoning or induced installation are not applicable.

checked_items.zh: 通读了仓库内的指令文件与全部说明文档（构建约定、发布流程、双语文档规则、架构说明），内容均为常规工程协作规范，未发现指令覆写、伪装系统消息、远程拉取指令、要求放行安全机制等注入措辞。
checked_items.en: Read through the instruction files and all documentation in the repository (build conventions, release process, bilingual documentation rules, architecture notes). The content is all routine engineering collaboration norms; no injection wording such as instruction override, disguised system messages, remote instruction fetching, or requests to relax security mechanisms was found.

evidence.zh: 插件未向模型注册任何工具，也没有注入系统提示片段，模型面对的文本面为空，工具描述投毒场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools with the model and injects no system prompt fragments. The text surface exposed to the model is empty; the tool description poisoning scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 插件没有任何面向模型的工具描述，不存在以提示词诱导模型安装插件、改写配置或放开权限的载体。
evidence.en: The plugin has no tool descriptions directed at the model, so there is no vehicle to induce the model via prompts to install plugins, rewrite configuration, or grant permissions.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部 YAML 配置：组合补丁仅插入插件自身一行，无可执行脚本标记；源码与构建产物中均未发现动态求值、动态执行、子进程调用等危险调用。
checked_items.en: Checked all YAML configuration: the combined patch only inserts the plugin's own single line, with no executable script markers. No dangerous calls such as dynamic evaluation, dynamic execution, or subprocess invocation were found in source code or build artifacts.

checked_items.zh: 安装钩子（prepare）为本地构建脚本，作用是在安装时重新生成预构建产物，不下载远程内容、不执行外部脚本，属常规工程做法。
checked_items.en: The install hook (prepare) is a local build script whose purpose is to regenerate the prebuilt artifacts at install time. It does not download remote content or execute external scripts; this is a routine engineering practice.

checked_items.zh: 核对两个 CI 工作流：一个运行文档门禁脚本（纯本地文件检查），一个在打标签时向 npm 官方源发布，均为常规工程流程。
checked_items.en: Reviewed two CI workflows: one runs a documentation gate script (purely local file checks), the other publishes to the official npm registry on tag creation. Both are routine engineering flows.

checked_items.zh: 核对浏览器端构建产物：仅做界面插槽注册、同源状态轮询、界面样式注入，无键盘/剪贴板监听、无凭据调用；产物与已精读的浏览器端源码一致，无混淆痕迹。
checked_items.en: Checked the browser-side build artifacts: they only perform view slot registration, same-origin status polling, and view style injection. There is no keyboard/clipboard listener and no credential calls. The artifacts match the fully reviewed browser-side source code, with no signs of obfuscation.

evidence.zh: 组合补丁（cordis.patch.yml）仅插入插件自身一行，不含任何可执行脚本标记，不存在配置被求值为代码的触发面。
evidence.en: The combined patch (cordis.patch.yml) only inserts the plugin's own single line and contains no executable script markers; there is no trigger surface where configuration could be evaluated as code.

evidence.zh: 插件为常驻组合插件，未调用动态定义/运行动态包工具，不存在把模型生成的代码塞进宿主执行的路径。
evidence.en: The plugin is a resident combined plugin and does not call tools for dynamic definition or running dynamic packages; there is no path that feeds model-generated code into the host for execution.

evidence.zh: 存在安装钩子（prepare），内容为本地构建重新生成预构建产物，无外联、无凭据读取、无隐蔽下载执行；两个 CI 工作流均为纯工程惯例，已核验排除。
evidence.en: An install hook (prepare) exists; its content is a local build that regenerates the prebuilt artifacts. There is no outbound connection, no credential reading, and no hidden download-and-execute. Both CI workflows are pure engineering conventions and have been verified and ruled out.

evidence.zh: 包声明了浏览器端模块并随附预构建产物；对浏览器端做了专项核对，未发现键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 等危险行为。
evidence.en: The package declares a browser-side module and ships prebuilt artifacts. A dedicated review of the browser side found no dangerous behaviors such as keyboard listening, clipboard reading, or credential RPC.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部外联面：运行时唯一网络活动是浏览器端对宿主 Web 服务同源快照接口的每秒轮询（回环地址），另 CI 中有向 npm 官方源的发布动作；未发现远程域名、隧道、回调通道、编码外发等外泄通道。
checked_items.en: Checked all outbound surfaces: the only runtime network activity is the browser-side polling of the host web service's same-origin snapshot endpoint every second (loopback address). Additionally, CI has a publish action to the official npm registry. No exfiltration channels such as remote domains, tunnels, callback channels, or encoded outbound data were found.

checked_items.zh: Node 半身在宿主 Web 服务上注册了一个只读快照接口，返回子代理运行元数据；不存在凭据读取与网络外发的组合。
checked_items.en: The Node half registers a read-only snapshot endpoint on the host web service that returns sub-agent runtime metadata; no combination of credential reading and network exfiltration exists.

evidence.zh: 运行时无凭据读取路径、无外部网络外发通道；唯一网络活动是浏览器端对宿主 Web 服务同源快照接口的轮询（回环地址），凭据+外联组合不存在。
evidence.en: At runtime there is no credential read path and no external network exfiltration channel. The only network activity is browser-side polling of the host web service's same-origin snapshot endpoint (loopback address); the credential-plus-outbound combination does not exist.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单：运行时依赖仅 react，其余均为官方宿主 SDK（@deepseek-ai 命名空间）的 peer 依赖，无仿冒包名、无未锁定版本的 git 依赖、无安装期拉取远程包的行为。
checked_items.en: Checked the dependency manifest: the only runtime dependency is react; all others are peer dependencies of the official host SDK (@deepseek-ai namespace). There are no spoofed package names, no git dependencies with unpinned versions, and no behavior of fetching remote packages at install time.

checked_items.zh: 核对组合补丁内容：只插入自身 bundle 行，未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用安全行，未改写注入/拦截配置。
checked_items.en: Checked the combined patch contents: it only inserts the plugin's own bundle line. It does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable security lines, and does not rewrite injection or interception configurations.

checked_items.zh: 首次审计无上一版本基线，无法进行版本间清单突变比对。
checked_items.en: This is the first audit, so there is no baseline from a previous version for comparison of manifest changes between versions.

evidence.zh: 组合补丁未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置，未禁用任何安全行，也未使用环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The combined patch does not touch security configurations such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, does not disable any security lines, and does not use environment-variable downgrade patterns.

evidence.zh: 插件只监听子代理启停事件与注册界面插槽，不监听审批、工具预执行等安全事件，不存在截断审批链的接触面。
evidence.en: The plugin only listens for sub-agent start/stop events and registers view slots. It does not listen for security events such as approvals or tool pre-execution, so there is no surface to truncate the approval chain.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无上一版本基线，无法比对版本间清单是否新增 bundle/client 声明。
evidence.en: This is the first-version audit without a previous baseline, so it is impossible to compare whether bundle/client declarations were added to the manifest between versions.

evidence.zh: 组合补丁未改写注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其挂起的篡改面。
evidence.en: The combined patch does not rewrite injection or interception configurations; there is no tampering surface that could append a mandatory service to a security plugin and cause it to hang.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自建 Web 服务或监听端口；在宿主 Web 服务上注册了一个只读快照接口（回环、无鉴权，返回子代理运行元数据），README 已披露此限制；该面属 DSH 生态固有的本机暴露特征，非本插件新增的恶意能力。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not create its own web service or listen on a port. It registers a read-only snapshot endpoint (loopback, no authentication, returning sub-agent runtime metadata) on the host web service; this limitation is disclosed in the README. This surface is an inherent local-exposure feature of the DSH ecosystem, not a malicious capability newly introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物，未做动态运行验证。
checked_items.en: No dynamic sandbox artifacts were provided in this environment, so dynamic runtime verification was not performed.

evidence.zh: 插件未自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口，仅借用宿主 Web 服务注册只读路由；宿主无鉴权 RPC 属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start its own web service or listen on a port; it merely borrows the host web service to register a read-only route. The host's unauthenticated RPC is an inherent ecosystem risk, not an issue with this plugin.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核对通过：包声明完整（浏览器端+组合 bundle），包名未仿冒官方命名空间，来源仓库与任务卡一致。
summary.en: Metadata and identity verification passed: the package declaration is complete (browser-side module plus combined bundle), the package name does not impersonate the official namespace, and the source repository matches the task card.

summary.zh: 静态扫描未发现配置执行、动态求值、子进程、凭据读取等危险模式；预扫 5 条命中已逐条核验排除（详见审计范围限制）。
summary.en: Static scanning found no dangerous patterns such as configuration execution, dynamic evaluation, subprocesses, or credential reads. The 5 pre-scan hits were each verified and ruled out (see audit scope limitations).

summary.zh: 行为面核对通过：安装钩子为本地构建；无混淆载荷；无敏感文件读取；无外部外联域名。
summary.en: Behavioral surface verification passed: the install hook is a local build; no obfuscated payload; no sensitive file reads; no external outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：无面向模型注册的工具或系统提示；指令文件与文档未发现注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no tools or system prompts registered for the model; no injection wording found in instruction files or documentation.

summary.zh: 未做动态沙箱验证（本环境无动态观测产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed (this environment has no dynamic observation artifacts).

target.zh: dsh-subagent-monitor@0.2.0#125278d4（完整审计；仓库根插件，无子路径）
target.en: dsh-subagent-monitor@0.2.0#125278d4 (full audit; repository root plugin, no sub-path)

limits.zh:
1. 本环境未提供动态沙箱产物（L4 未启用），未做动态运行验证。

2. 包清单未显式声明网络/命令/文件/模型面对能力，declared_capabilities 为按代码实测推断。

3. 静态预扫 5 条命中已逐条核验并排除：DSH-X07（DG-R3-59）两条 CI 工作流均为常规工程流程（文档门禁、npm 官方源发布）；DSH-X10（DG-R2-57）AGENTS.md 为常规仓库协作规范，无注入措辞；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）lib/client.js.map 为标准 sourcemap 构建产物，内嵌源码与提交源码一致，无混淆；DSH-X02（DG-R3-54）prepare 安装钩子为本地构建，无远程下载执行。

4. docs/screenshot.png 为二进制截图，未做内容核验；lib/client.js 为构建产物，读取了头部并做全文危险模式扫描，其内容与已全文精读的浏览器端源码一致。
limits.en:
1. This environment did not provide dynamic sandbox artifacts (L4 not enabled), so dynamic runtime verification was not performed.

2. The package manifest does not explicitly declare network/command/file/model-facing capabilities; declared_capabilities is inferred from code measurement.

3. The 5 static pre-scan hits were each verified and ruled out: DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59) — both CI workflows are routine engineering flows (documentation gate, publish to official npm registry); DSH-X10 (DG-R2-57) — AGENTS.md is routine repository collaboration norms with no injection wording; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) — lib/client.js.map is a standard sourcemap build artifact whose embedded source matches the committed source, with no obfuscation; DSH-X02 (DG-R3-54) — the prepare install hook is a local build with no remote download-and-execute.

4. docs/screenshot.png is a binary screenshot and was not content-verified. lib/client.js is a build artifact; its header was read and a full dangerous-pattern scan was performed, and its content matches the fully reviewed browser-side source code.
